applications.title: TYPE ONE stable bars by car make and model
applications.description: Find TYPE ONE strut bars, anti-roll bars and lower bars by car make, model and bar type, with the part code and material for each.
applications.intro: Filter by car make, bar type or upgrade stage, or search by model or part code.

how-it-fits.title: Where TYPE ONE stable bars fit: 3D mounting guide
how-it-fits.description: See where each TYPE ONE bar bolts onto the chassis in a 3D model and in photos of real cars, and which bars to fit first.
how-it-fits.intro: Turn the 3D chassis to see the six bar positions, then see them fitted on real cars. The three upgrade stages show which bars to fit first.

manufacturing.title: How TYPE ONE stable bars are made in Kuala Lumpur
manufacturing.description: The eight production stages behind every TYPE ONE strut bar and solid anti-roll bar, from raw steel screening to powder coating and final checks.
manufacturing.intro: Two production lines in Desa Aman, Kuala Lumpur: one for strut and lower bars, one for solid anti-roll bars. Each runs eight stages from raw steel to the final check.

about.title: About TYPE ONE: Malaysian stable bar maker since 2017
about.description: TYPE ONE designs and makes chassis stable bars in Kuala Lumpur and sells them in 15 countries. Our vision, mission and export markets.
about.intro: A Malaysian maker of chassis stable bars, founded in Kuala Lumpur in 2017 and now selling in 15 countries.

contact.title: Contact TYPE ONE: dealers, fitting and warranty
contact.description: Ask TYPE ONE about bars for your car, apply to become a dealer, or register the lifetime warranty on a bar you have fitted.
contact.intro: Ask about bars for your car, apply to sell TYPE ONE, or register your lifetime warranty.
